Rahul Gandhi removed from PM Modi's residence; clashes reported

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi was removed from Prime Minister Narendra Modi's residence. Following this event, clashes between BJP and Congress workers occurred in Vijayawada. The incidents are linked to Rahul Gandhi's protest outside the Prime Minister's residence.
